requirements.summary: Emergency changes require explicit bounded emergency authority with scope, time, target and post-event review.
Required separation of duties prevents the executor logical principal from satisfying an independent approval obligation.
Every approval binds exact ChangeRevision, target digest, impact assessment version and recovery-plan version.
Create, approve, execute, emergency-authorize, recovery and close are separately authorizable change actions.
Secret values use 021P-compatible references and are never persisted plaintext in change plans or receipts.
Break-glass preserves real principal, granted scope, reason, time and review obligation.
